name: Vapora — Process Studio
summary: Browser-based process-flowsheet editor and steady-state simulator with ideal-mixture thermodynamics, run locally without dependencies.
description: A dependency-free web app for editing process flowsheets and running steady-state calculations: place equipment with typed material and energy ports, set specifications, and a worker-based engine performs material and energy balances, ideal-mixture phase equilibrium, unit-operation calculations and recycle convergence. Ships with CSV/JSON export, sensitivity studies, stream and phase reports and a benzene/toluene example that calculates on startup; served from Node.js 20+ and MIT licensed.
contains: editable flowsheets with typed material and energy ports, undo/redo and persistence
unit ops: mixers, splitters, heaters, coolers, pumps, valves, TP/PH flash separators
model: IDEAL-RAOULT and IDEAL-GAS property methods, recycle convergence
benzene/toluene recovery example calculated on startup
stream/phase reports, balance residuals, CSV/JSON export, sensitivity studies
54 engine tests, 11 numerical checks, 22 browser integration checks
runs locally on Node.js 20+, no package installation, MIT licensed
